name: Grandjoy Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Grandjoy Holdings Group Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate development, operation, and sale, leasing, and management of residential and commercial properties in China and internationally. It offers residential, commercial properties, industrial properties, office building, apartment, as well as hotel operations. The company was formerly known as COFCO Property Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Grandjoy Holdings Group Co., Ltd. in March 2019. Grandjoy Holdings Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is based in Beijing, China.
